S01: Three brothers traveled toward the capital of a neighboring kingdom.
S02: After some time they resolved to stop and rest.
S03: Before them rose an old, silent building.
S04: The door opened with a heavy sound.
S05: Inside they found a chamber and lay down to sleep.
S06: The youngest brother fell into a deep sleep, without a care.
S07: At night, something entered their chamber.
S10: The two older brothers woke and were afraid.
S12: The youngest sensed nothing and still slept.
S13: The beasts circled, but did not touch him.
S14: When he woke, he set out to find his brothers.
S15: He entered a vast, overgrown garden.
S16: In the fountain was a girl trapped beneath the ice.
S17: Her face was beautiful and serene.
S18: The young man leaned over the cold surface.
S19: Youngest brother: "What are you doing here?"
S20: Queen: "I am the queen of this castle, and I am cursed."
S21: Queen: "If you spend two more nights here without fleeing, you will free me."
S24: He woke when it grew dark.
S25: He descended the stairs toward the cellar.
S26: He descended step by step into the darkness.
S27: Below was a cellar with iron cells.
S28: He hid behind a pillar and waited.
S29: The first night, the lion entered the cellar.
S30: The young man held his breath.
S31: The lion entered one of the cells.
S32: The young man leaped and shut the door.
S34: The lion remained trapped behind the bars.
S35: The next night, the wolf entered the cellar.
S36: The wolf circled, then entered a cell.
S37: Just as with the lion, he locked the wolf in too.
S39: The young man set out toward the fountain.
S41: He gazed into the queen's face.
S42: The first rays touched the fountain.
S44: The ice broke, and the queen rose.
S46: She smiled at him in the rays of dawn.
